value.rationale: Complete natural first-range site-deletion classification of the ordinary matching complexes of 3-row rectangular grids across n=4,5,6, at every site symmetry orbit. The n=4 middle-row end deletion changes the nonzero homology dimension from three to two, and n=6 gives five distinct exact integral fifth-Betti ranks. Site failure is the fundamental multi-edge perturbation of matching complexes, not an arbitrary parameter slice, and the exact positional values can support relative deletion and robustness arguments. The proof is full integral homotopy, not re-tabulation of known full-grid or one-edge results; no sweeping consequence is claimed.
